Job Description

Are you an enthusiastic and skilled individual looking to take your career to the next level ? See what I did there... Join us at Wilco Contractors Northwest Inc as a Gradesperson ! In this role, you will work closely with the Operators and Foreman to interpret and follow project blueprints and specifications, ensuring proper grades are achieved throughout the project. At Wilco, we pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence in civil construction. We tackle a diverse range of projects, from environmental works to park construction, and we need talented individuals like you to help us achieve our goals! Your days will be filled with exciting challenges as you: Perform grades and layout measurements to ensure accurate project implementation using a level and tape method Measure and mark quantities of materials Provide accurate cut and fill directions Monitor and check grade elevations throughout the day to ensure project specifications are met Maintain a clean and organized worksite and assist with traffic control as needed Champion safety practices while fostering a positive team environment Maintain accurate daily records and site notes as required We put our people first and believe that each member of our team plays an essential role in our success. Join us and be part of our exciting journey!
